statements.status_notes: Debian has not yet shipped a fixed libio-socket-ssl-perl for trixie. This DHI rebuild backports upstream commit 6e756466cd7005bcdb2e0e18eb140f33a2355c78 (https://github.com/noxxi/p5-io-socket-ssl/commit/6e756466cd7005bcdb2e0e18eb140f33a2355c78), which makes the public suffix list update stop with an error when a fetched line would end the built-in data section, so fetched lines can no longer run as Perl code. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-129892

Debian has not yet shipped a fixed libio-socket-ssl-perl for trixie. This DHI rebuild backports upstream commit 6e756466cd7005bcdb2e0e18eb140f33a2355c78 (https://github.com/noxxi/p5-io-socket-ssl/commit/6e756466cd7005bcdb2e0e18eb140f33a2355c78), which changes the default public suffix list update URL from http to https. The default update path therefore no longer fetches the list over cleartext HTTP. An explicit http:// URL passed by the caller is still fetched as requested. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-129891
